outputs.explanation: This is a stacked area/bar plot showing median state frequencies across a continuum of Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters aggregated into many bins). Like a line plot depicting a continuous trend, overlaying individual data points across this many bins/promoters would make the plot unreadable, so it is exempt from requiring individual points.

The main visualization is a single-molecule stack in which each row represents one individual DNA molecule (2952 molecules shown), so the individual data underlying the aggregated state-frequency sidebar is directly displayed.

Same representation as panel A: a stacked area/bar plot of median state frequencies across binned Pol II ChIP-seq levels (n=6122 promoters), analogous to a continuous trend line plot, so individual points are not required.
As in panel B, each row of the single-molecule stack (2871 molecules) represents an individual data point underlying the aggregated frequency sidebar, so individual data are shown.
This is a box plot, which already conveys the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers) and is exempt from requiring overlaid individual points per the check guidelines.
